q: Under federal rules, what is the minimum score needed to pass each CDL knowledge test?
e: 49 CFR 383.135 requires at least 80% correct on each knowledge test.

q: How long must you hold a commercial learner's permit (CLP) before you can take the CDL skills test?
e: 49 CFR 383.25(e): no skills test in the first 14 days after the CLP is first issued.

q: What is the longest a CLP can be valid without retaking the knowledge tests?
e: 49 CFR 383.25(c): no more than one year from initial issuance.

q: In what order are the three CDL skills test segments given?
a: Pre-trip inspection, basic vehicle control, on-road

q: Which endorsements may appear on a CLP?
a: Passenger, school bus and tank only
e: 49 CFR 383.25(a)(5): P, S and N only; all others are prohibited on a CLP.

q: A CLP holder with a tank (N) endorsement may drive which tank vehicles?
a: Only empty tank vehicles, purged of any hazmat residue

q: May a CLP holder drive a vehicle transporting hazardous materials?
Where must the supervising CDL holder sit when a CLP holder drives a truck?
a: In the front seat next to the CLP holder

q: An Entry-Level Driver Training provider must be listed where?
Can an interpreter be used during the CDL skills test?
e: 49 CFR 383.133(c)(5): interpreters are prohibited; the test is conducted in English.

q: If you fail the air brake knowledge test but get a CLP or CDL, what happens?
a: An air brake restriction is placed on the license

q: If you fail the combination vehicles knowledge test, which license can you not be issued?
Taking the skills test in a truck with an automatic transmission results in what?
If you retake a failed knowledge test, the state must give you:
a: A different version of the test

q: Before issuing or renewing a CDL, states must check which federal database for drug and alcohol violations?
e: FMCSA Clearinghouse-II, in effect since Nov 18, 2024.

q: When entering or leaving the cab, how many points of contact should you keep?
e: State CDL manuals (e.g. California DL 650) teach three points of contact.

q: When you get out of the vehicle during the inspection test, you should first:
a: Set the parking brake and put it in neutral
Leave the engine at high idle
e: California Commercial Driver Handbook, vehicle inspection section.

q: A low air pressure warning must come on before tank pressure falls below:
In most trucks, spring brakes come on automatically when air pressure drops to roughly:
Below 40 mph, how much following distance should you leave?
a: One second for every 10 feet of vehicle length
e: CDL manual, Space Management. Add one more second above 40 mph.

q: On a one-way or divided highway, where should you place warning devices when stopped?
e: CDL manual, Stopping on the Road.

q: Hydroplaning can happen at speeds as low as:
e: CDL manual, Driving in Bad Weather.

q: How far ahead should you look while driving?
A vehicle carrying placarded hazardous materials must have placards on how many sides?
Who may ride as a passenger when a CLP holder with a P endorsement drives a bus?
a: Only examiners, auditors/inspectors, other trainees and the supervising CDL holder
